name: El Paso Public Library volunteer program
what_you_do: Volunteer at the public library. The program page does not list the tasks.
who_can_apply: Age 14 or older. Volunteers 17 and up must have a state-issued ID.
duration: Not stated on the program page
deadline_text: No deadline stated on the program page. As of Nov 4, 2026, the city posting it links to shows a closing date of Feb 19, 2025. Call to ask if the library still takes volunteers.
how_to_apply: The program page links to a City of El Paso volunteer posting. That posting shows a closing date of Feb 19, 2025. Call the Main Library at (915) 212-READ to ask how to apply.
notes: The program page does not say which library branches need teen help. Call the Main Library at (915) 212-READ to ask.
